name: VoiceDrop
summary: Ringless voicemail platform for US outreach with AI voices, voice cloning, CRM and Zapier integrations, and usage-based pricing.
best_for: US sales teams, lenders and local service businesses that want to send personalised voicemails at volume and pay per delivered message
skip_if: you contact people outside the US, you want to reach landlines, you cannot confirm that your list and message comply with phone marketing rules, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Delivery is US only and excludes landlines. The callback rates on the page are the vendor's own and cannot be checked. A card is needed for the trial. We have not checked the rules on ringless voicemail in your state, so ask before you send to a purchased list.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Budget · Budget $95 a month with 500 voice units
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-15 on voicedrop.ai/pricing and the home page FAQ, US dollars a month) VoiceDrop sells ringless voicemail by usage units. Budget costs $95 a month for 500 units and 1,000 static voicemails, with one voice clone seat and no account manager. Individual costs $495 a month for 6,500 units. Growth costs $995 a month for 15,000 units and includes an account manager. Scale costs $1,995 a month for 40,000 units. Enterprise has custom pricing from 1,000,000 units. One unit spans 150 to 500 characters of your script and a static recording costs 0.5 units. You are charged only for successful deliveries, and unused units roll over for 90 days. Choosing quarterly billing saves 8% and annual billing gives 2 months free. A card is needed for the 7-day free trial, which includes $20 of credits, about 200 messages. Calls that come in to your VoiceDrop numbers cost 2 cents a minute, rounded up to the full minute. We have not paid for a plan.
